title: Stasis Motorcycle Leap
description: A hooded skeletal rider with glowing white eyes and flowing blue energy trails speeds on a flaming motorcycle, launching off a crumbling stone bridge. Below, two monstrous skull-faced creatures with wide open mouths and long tongues emerge from the darkness, while black birds fly around a large cracked celestial orb in a starry night sky.
prompt: A hooded skeletal figure with glowing white eyes and long flowing blue energy cape rides a flaming motorcycle, leaping across a crumbling gothic stone bridge at night. Two giant monstrous skulls with wide open mouths and long tongues emerge from below the bridge. A large cracked celestial orb with constellations and pink cherry blossoms floats in the starry sky, black birds flying around. Dramatic dark fantasy scene with sparks and motion, signed JLX3 and Stasis
